standard_prerequisites.name: Term model and term values
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies M(Gamma*) and the fact that every closed term denotes itself, which the atomic and quantifier cases read off.

standard_prerequisites.name: Closure clauses for complete consistent sets
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the membership facts assembled by the induction hypothesis into membership of the compound sentence in the connective cases.

standard_prerequisites.name: Saturation instances
standard_prerequisites.use: Closes the quantifier cases: all instances in Gamma* iff the universal sentence belongs; an instance in Gamma* iff the existential belongs.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1311-1316): for sentences A not containing the identity symbol, M(Gamma*) satisfies A iff A in Gamma*.
Simultaneous induction on A (proof lines 1318-1409): falsity and truth cases from the satisfaction definitions plus consistency (and completeness for truth).
Atomic case R(t1,...,tn): satisfaction iff the tuple lies in the interpretation of R, which by the term model construction holds iff R(t1,...,tn) in Gamma*.
Negation case: satisfaction of not-B iff B is not satisfied; induction hypothesis gives B not in Gamma*; completeness and consistency convert this to not-B in Gamma*.
Conjunction, disjunction and conditional cases: satisfaction clauses plus induction hypothesis, closed by the prop:ccs conjunction/disjunction/conditional clauses.

Quantifier cases (final two tagitems, FOL branch): M(Gamma*) satisfies forall x B(x) iff B(t) is satisfied for all terms (prop:quant-termmodel), induction hypothesis per term, then prop:saturated-instances closes to membership; existential case dual.
proof_roadmap: Run one simultaneous induction over sentences.
Handle the zero-ary and atomic cases directly from the satisfaction definition and the term model construction.
Route the connective cases through the prop:ccs closure clauses and the quantifier cases through quant-termmodel plus saturated-instances.
difficulty_reason: Truth Lemma (statement 1311-1316, proof 1318-1409): full simultaneous induction with every case carried - connectives through the closure clauses, quantifiers through quant-termmodel and saturated-instances; nothing delegated. H3.
